title: Laredo Fire Department and Doctors Hospital Launch Food Drive for Families in Need
excerpt: The Laredo Fire Department and Doctors Hospital of Laredo are collecting non-perishable food and canned goods for local families through Monday, Nov. 16, with donations accepted at the Fire Department Administration Center, 616 E. Del Mar Blvd.
content:
The Laredo Fire Department and Doctors Hospital of Laredo have launched a food drive collecting non-perishable food and canned goods for families in need in the Laredo community, timed for the Thanksgiving season, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The drive began Thursday and runs through Monday, Nov. 16. Donations can be dropped off at the Laredo Fire Department Administration Center, 616 E. Del Mar Blvd.

Items being collected include canned vegetables, beans and soup; rice, pasta and cereal; juice; peanut butter and canned protein; cooking oil and spices; and canned tuna.

"We are asking our amazing community to step up and help make a difference," the Laredo Fire Department said. "Your donations of canned goods and non-perishable food items can help put food on the table for families who need it most."

For more information, the organizers direct residents to contact the Laredo Fire Department or Doctors Hospital of Laredo.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 14, 2026.
